answer: A juniper fire lit on one island cannot warm another. Each epoch, thirty islands open one mooring each, and a claimant hauls its anchor across four in twenty minutes, each handoff witnessed by a stranger, at most two each. Entry locks 75 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,325 POA. One operator carries two anchors at most, so ten fakes need five hands, forty handoffs, twenty strangers at once. A missed handoff burns 20; an anchor shown twice burns both bonds. The chain reads handoff times against funding roots: ten anchors behind one hand collapse into one.
